Array.from(seg.segment(clean)).map(function(item){return item.segment.trim();}).filter(Boolean);\n          } catch (e) {}\n        }\n        var matches = clean.match(/[^.!?]+(?:[.!?]+[\"'”’)]*|$)/g);\n        return (matches || [clean]).map(function(s){return s.trim();}).filter(Boolean);\n      }\n      function paragraphSplit(text) {\n        var raw = String(text || '').replace(/\\r\\n/g,'\\n');\n        var paragraphs = raw.split(/\\n\\s*\\n+/).map(normalizeSpace).filter(Boolean);\n        if (paragraphs.length > 1) return paragraphs;\n        var sentences = sentenceSplit(raw);\n        if (sentences.length <= 5) return paragraphs.length ? paragraphs : sentences;\n        var result = [];\n        for (var i=0;i<sentences.length;i+=4) result.push(sentences.slice(i,i+4).join(' '));\n        return result;\n      }\n      function splitSentenceMaterial(text,mode,targetWords) {\n        if (mode === 'paragraph') return paragraphSplit(text);\n        var sentences = sentenceSplit(text);\n        if (mode === 'sentence') return sentences;\n        var result=[], bucket=[], count=0;\n        sentences.forEach(function(sentence){\n          if (bucket.length && count >= targetWords) { result.push(bucket.join(' ')); bucket=[]; count=0; }\n          bucket.push(sentence); count += wordCount(sentence);\n        });\n        if (bucket.length) result.push(bucket.join(' '));\n        return result;\n      }\n\n      function openDatabase() {\n        return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){\n          if (!window.indexedDB) { reject(new Error('IndexedDB unavailable')); return; }\n          var request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME,1);\n          request.onupgradeneeded = function(){\n            var db = request.result;\n            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(LIBRARY_STORE)) db.createObjectStore(LIBRARY_STORE,{keyPath:'id'});\n            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(HANDLE_STORE)) db.createObjectStore(HANDLE_STORE);\n          };\n          request.onsuccess = function(){resolve(request.result);};\n          request.onerror = function(){reject(request.error || new Error('Database unavailable'));};\n        });\n      }\n      async function dbGetAll(storeName) {\n        var db = await openDatabase();\n        return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){\n          var tx=db.transaction(storeName,'readonly'); var req=tx.objectStore(storeName).getAll();\n          req.onsuccess=function(){resolve(req.result||[]);}; req.onerror=function(){reject(req.error);}; tx.oncomplete=function(){db.close();};\n        });\n      }\n      async function dbPut(storeName,value,key) {\n        var db=await openDatabase();\n        return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){\n          var tx=db.transaction(storeName,'readwrite'); var store=tx.objectStore(storeName); if(key===undefined) store.put(value); else store.put(value,key);\n          tx.oncomplete=function(){db.close();resolve();}; tx.onerror=function(){db.close();reject(tx.error);};\n        });\n      }\n      async function dbDelete(storeName,key) {\n        var db=await openDatabase();\n        return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){\n          var tx=db.transaction(storeName,'readwrite'); tx.objectStore(storeName).delete(key);\n          tx.oncomplete=function(){db.close();resolve();}; tx.onerror=function(){db.close();reject(tx.error);};\n        });\n      }\n      async function dbClear(storeName) {\n        var db=await openDatabase();\n        return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){\n          var tx=db.transaction(storeName,'readwrite'); tx.objectStore(storeName).clear();\n          tx.oncomplete=function(){db.close();resolve();}; tx.onerror=function(){db.close();reject(tx.error);};\n        });\n      }\n      async function refreshLibrary() {\n        var custom=[];\n        try { custom=await dbGetAll(LIBRARY_STORE); } catch(e) { custom=[]; }\n        libraryCache=BUILTIN_LIBRARY.concat(custom.sort(function(a,b){return String(b.createdAt||'').localeCompare(String(a.createdAt||''));}));\n        renderLibrary();\n      }\n      async function storeDirectoryHandle(handle) { await dbPut(HANDLE_STORE,handle,HANDLE_KEY); }\n      async function restoreDirectoryHandle() {\n        var db=await openDatabase();\n        return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){\n          var tx=db.transaction(HANDLE_STORE,'readonly'); var req=tx.objectStore(HANDLE_STORE).get(HANDLE_KEY);\n          req.onsuccess=function(){resolve(req.result||null);}; req.onerror=function(){reject(req.error);}; tx.oncomplete=function(){db.close();};\n        });\n      }\n\n      function migrateLegacy() {\n        try {\n          var legacy=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LEGACY_STORAGE_KEY)||'null');\n          if (!legacy || !Array.isArray(legacy.segments) || !legacy.segments.length) return null;\n          var next=defaultState();\n          next.fontSize=[16,18,20].indexOf(Number(legacy.fontSize))>=0?Number(legacy.fontSize):18;\n          next.sentence.title=legacy.title||'Migrated Practice';\n          next.sentence.text=legacy.source||legacy.segments.join(' ');\n          next.sentence.segments=legacy.segments;\n          next.sentence.answers=Array.isArray(legacy.answers)?legacy.answers:new Array(legacy.segments.length).fill('');\n          next.sentence.notes=Array.isArray(legacy.notes)?legacy.notes:new Array(legacy.segments.length).fill('');\n          next.sentence.current=clamp(Number(legacy.current)||0,0,legacy.segments.length-1);\n          next.sentence.mode=legacy.mode==='copy'?'copy':'imitate';\n          return next;\n        } catch(e) { return null; }\n      }\n      function loadState() {\n        try {\n          var saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)||'null');\n          if (saved && saved.schemaVersion===4) state=Object.assign(defaultState(),saved);\n          else {\n            var migrated=migrateLegacy();\n            if (migrated) { state=migrated; localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify(state)); }\n          }\n        } catch(e) { state=defaultState(); }\n        normalizeState();\n      }\n      function normalizeState() {\n        if (['sentence','paragraph','library'].indexOf(state.activeLab)<0) state.activeLab='sentence';\n        if ([16,18,20].indexOf(Number(state.fontSize))<0) state.fontSize=18;\n        state.sentence=Object.assign(defaultState().sentence,state.sentence||{});\n        state.paragraph=Object.assign(defaultState().paragraph,state.paragraph||{});\n        state.sentence.segments=Array.isArray(state.sentence.segments)?state.sentence.segments:[];\n        state.sentence.answers=Array.isArray(state.sentence.answers)?state.sentence.answers:[];\n        state.sentence.notes=Array.isArray(state.sentence.notes)?state.sentence.notes:[];\n        while(state.sentence.answers.length<state.sentence.segments.length) state.sentence.answers.push('');\n        while(state.sentence.notes.length<state.sentence.segments.length) state.sentence.notes.push('');\n        state.sentence.current=clamp(Number(state.sentence.current)||0,0,Math.max(0,state.sentence.segments.length-1));\n        state.paragraph.paragraphs=Array.isArray(state.paragraph.paragraphs)?state.paragraph.paragraphs:[];\n        state.paragraph.records=Array.isArray(state.paragraph.records)?state.paragraph.records:[];\n        while(state.paragraph.records.length<state.paragraph.paragraphs.length) state.paragraph.records.push(emptyParagraphRecord(state.paragraph.paragraphs[state.paragraph.records.length]));\n        state.paragraph.current=clamp(Number(state.paragraph.current)||0,0,Math.max(0,state.paragraph.paragraphs.length-1));\n      }\n      function persistNow() { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify(state)); updateAutosave('已自动保存'); }\n      function scheduleSave() { updateAutosave('正在保存…'); clearTimeout(saveTimer); saveTimer=setTimeout(persistNow,250); }\n      function updateAutosave(text) { if(byId('sentenceAutosave')) byId('sentenceAutosave').textContent=text; }\n      function showToast(message) { var el=byId('toast'); el.textContent=message; el.classList.add('show'); clearTimeout(toastTimer); toastTimer=setTimeout(function(){el.classList.remove('show');},2100); }\n\n      function setActiveLab(lab) {\n        commitVisibleFields();\n        state.activeLab=lab;\n        scheduleSave();\n        renderAll();\n      }\n      function renderAll() {\n        document.body.dataset.labActive=state.activeLab;\n        document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--practice-font',state.fontSize+'px');\n        all('.lab-tab').forEach(function(btn){btn.classList.toggle('active',btn.dataset.lab===state.activeLab);});\n        all('.view').forEach(function(view){view.classList.remove('active');});\n        byId(state.activeLab+'View').classList.add('active');\n        byId('sentenceCoach').style.display=state.activeLab==='sentence'?'block':'none';\n        byId('paragraphCoach').style.display=state.activeLab==='paragraph'?'block':'none';\n        byId('libraryCoach').style.display=state.activeLab==='library'?'block':'none';\n        byId('openLibraryBtn').style.display=state.activeLab==='library'?'none':'inline-block';\n        byId('progressWrap').style.display=state.activeLab==='library'?'none':'block';\n        if(state.activeLab==='sentence') renderSentenceLab();\n        else if(state.activeLab==='paragraph') renderParagraphLab();\n        else renderLibrary();\n        renderLeftPanel();\n      }\n\n      function renderLeftPanel() {\n        var list=byId('unitList'); list.innerHTML='';\n        if(state.activeLab==='library') {\n          byId('leftTitle').textContent='练习库说明'; byId('sourceName').textContent='本地优先';\n          byId('sourceInfo').textContent='内置原创材料不会改变；你添加的材料保存在 IndexedDB，并随备份导出。';\n          return;\n        }\n        if(state.activeLab==='sentence') {\n          var s=state.sentence; byId('leftTitle').textContent='句子练习目录'; byId('sourceName').textContent=s.title||'尚未选择材料';\n          byId('sourceInfo').textContent=s.segments.length?(s.segments.length+' 个单元 · '+wordCount(s.text)+' 词'):'从练习库选择或添加一篇文本。';\n          var practiced=s.answers.filter(function(v){return String(v||'').trim();}).length; var '+s.segments.length+' 已练习 · '+percent+'%'):'尚未开始';\n          s.segments.forEach(function(segment,index){\n            var answer=String(s.answers[index]||'').trim(); var done=sentenceDone(index); var btn=document.createElement('button');\n            btn.className='unit-item'+(index===s.current?' active':''); btn.innerHTML='<span class=\"unit-num\">'+(index+1)+'</span><span btn.addEventListener('click',function(){commitVisibleFields();s.current=index;scheduleSave();renderAll();byId('sentenceWriter').focus();}); list.appendChild(btn);\n          });\n          return;\n        }\n        var p=state.paragraph; byId('leftTitle').textContent='段落练习目录'; byId('sourceName').textContent=p.title||'尚未选择材料';\n        byId('sourceInfo').textContent=p.paragraphs.length?(p.paragraphs.length+' 个段落 · '+wordCount(p.text)+' 词'):'从练习库选择含完整段落的材料。';\n        var started=0; p.records.forEach(function(record){if(paragraphRecordStarted(record)) started++;}); var pcent=p.paragraphs.length?Math.round(started/p.paragraphs.length*100):0;\n        byId('progressBar').style.width=pcent+'%'; byId('progressText').textContent=p.paragraphs.length?(started+' / '+p.paragraphs.length+' 已开始 · '+pcent+'%'):'尚未开始';\n        p.paragraphs.forEach(function(paragraph,index){var record=p.records[index]||emptyParagraphRecord(paragraph); var btn=document.createElement('button'); btn.className='unit-item'+(index===p.current?' active':''); btn.innerHTML='<span class=\"unit-num\">'+(index+1)+'</span><span class=\"unit-preview\">'+escapeHtml(paragraph)+'</span><span class=\"unit-state '+(paragraphRecordDone(record)?'done':paragraphRecordStarted(record)?'started':'')+'\"></span>'; btn.addEventListener('click',function(){commitVisibleFields();p.current=index;scheduleSave();renderAll();}); list.appendChild(btn);});\n      }\n\n      function renderSentenceLab() {\n        var s=state.sentence; var has=s.segments.length>0; byId('sentenceEmpty').style.display=has?'none':'grid'; byId('sentencePractice').style.display=has?'block':'none';\n        byId('fontSizeSelect').value=String(state.fontSize); byId('sentenceModeSelect').value=s.mode; byId('splitModeSelect').value=s.splitMode;\n        if(!has){renderSentenceAnalysis('');return;}\n        s.current=clamp(s.current,0,s.segments.length-1); var target=s.segments[s.current]||''; var answer=s.answers[s.current]||'';\n        byId('sentenceUnitLabel').textContent='Practice '+(s.current+1)+' / '+s.segments.length; byId('sentenceHeading').textContent=s.mode==='copy'?'精准跟写':'结构仿写';\n        byId('sentenceWriter').value=answer; byId('sentenceWriter').placeholder=s.mode==='copy'?'按原文逐字输入，系统会标记字符差异……':'参考原文结构、搭配或逻辑，写出自己的句子或短段……';\n        byId('sentencePrevBtn').disabled=s.current<=0; byId('sentenceNextBtn').disabled=s.current>=s.segments.length-1; byId('sentenceNote').value=s.notes[s.current]||'';\n        renderSentenceTarget(target,answer); renderSentenceStats(target,answer); renderSentenceAnalysis(target);\n      }\n      function renderSentenceTarget(target,answer) {\n        if(state.sentence.mode!=='copy'){byId('sentenceTarget').textContent=target;return;}\n        var html=''; for(var i=0;i<target.length;i++){var cls='target-char'; if(i<answer.length) cls+=answer[i]===target[i]?' correct':' wrong'; else if(i===answer.length) cls+=' current'; html+='<span class=\"'+cls+'\">'+escapeHtml(target[i])+'</span>';}\n        if(answer.length>target.length) html+='<span class=\"target-char wrong\">'+escapeHtml(answer.slice(target.length))+'</span>'; byId('sentenceTarget').innerHTML=html;\n      }\n      function levenshtein(a,b){a=String(a||'');b=String(b||'');if(!a.length)return b.length;if(!b.length)return a.length;var prev=new Array(b.length+1),curr=new Array(b.length+1);for(var j=0;j<=b.length;j++)prev[j]=j;for(var i=1;i<=a.length;i++){curr[0]=i;for(var k=1;k<=b.length;k++){var cost=a[i-1]===b[k-1]?0:1;curr[k]=Math.min(curr[k-1]+1,prev[k]+1,prev[k-1]+cost);}var t=prev;prev=curr;curr=t;}return prev[b.length];}\n      function sentenceAccuracy(target,answer){if(!answer.length)return null;var max=Math.max(target.length,answer.length,1);return Math.max(0,Math.round((1-levenshtein(target,answer)/max)*100));}\n      function renderSentenceStats(target,answer){var accuracy=sentenceAccuracy(target,answer);byId('sentenceWordStat').textContent=wordCount(answer);byId('sentenceCharStat').textContent=answer.length;byId('sentenceAccuracyStat').textContent=state.sentence.mode==='copy'&&accuracy!==null?accuracy+'%':'—';byId('sentenceCompletionStat').textContent=Math.min(999,Math.round(answer.length/Math.max(target.length,1)*100))+'%';}\n      function sentenceDone(index){var s=state.sentence,answer=String(s.answers[index]||'').trim();if(!answer)return false;if(s.mode==='copy'){var target=s.segments[index]||'';return sentenceAccuracy(target,answer)>=95&&answer.length>=target.length*.9;}return wordCount(answer)>=Math.max(4,Math.round(wordCount(s.segments[index]||'')*.45));}\n      function handleSentenceInput(){var      function renderSentenceAnalysis(text){var words=wordCount(text),sentences=sentenceSplit(text),avg=sentences.length?Math.round(words/sentences.length):0;byId('analysisWords').textContent=words;byId('analysisSentences').textContent=sentences.length;byId('analysisAvg').textContent=avg;byId('analysisLevel').textContent=avg>=30?'Long':avg>=18?'Medium':'Short';var lower=' '+String(text||'').toLowerCase()+' ';var connectors=[];connectorGroups.forEach(function(group){var found=group.values.filter(function(v){return lower.indexOf(' '+v+' ')>=0;});if(found.length)connectors.push(group.name+'：'+found.join(', '));});renderChips('connectorChips',connectors,'未识别到明显连接词');var patterns=[];if(/\\bwhich\\b|\\bthat\\b|\\bwho\\b/i.test(text))patterns.push('可能包含定语或名词性从句');if(/\\b(is|are|was|were|be|been|being)\\s+\\w+(ed|en)\\b/i.test(text))patterns.push('可能包含被动语态');if(/\\b(can|could|may|might|must|should|would)\\b/i.test(text))patterns.push('使用了情态动词，注意语气强弱');if(/\\balthough\\b|\\bthough\\b|\\bwhile\\b|\\bwhereas\\b/i.test(text))patterns.push('包含让步或对比结构');if(/;|:/.test(text))patterns.push('使用分号或冒号组织信息');var list=byId('patternList');list.innerHTML='';if(!patterns.length)list.innerHTML='<li class=\"analysis-empty\">未识别到明显结构；这不等于句子简单或有问题。</li>';else patterns.forEach(function(v){var li=document.createElement('li');li.textContent=v;list.appendChild(li);});var phrases=academicPhrases.filter(function(p){return lower.indexOf(' '+p+' ')>=0;});renderChips('phraseChips',phrases,'暂无规则匹配结果');}\n      function renderChips(id,items,emptyText){var el=byId(id);el.innerHTML='';if(!items.length){el.innerHTML='<span chip=document.createElement('span');chip.className='chip';chip.textContent=item;el.appendChild(chip);});}\n\n      function renderParagraphLab(){var '+(p.current+1)+' / '+p.paragraphs.length;var      function ensureParagraphRecord(index){var p=state.paragraph;while(p.records.length<p.paragraphs.length)p.records.push(emptyParagraphRecord(p.paragraphs[p.records.length]));var      function currentParagraphRecord(){ensureParagraphRecord(state.paragraph.current);return state.paragraph.records[state.paragraph.current];}\n      function renderBreakdown(){var      function renderGuided(){var rec=currentParagraphRecord();all('[data-guided]').forEach(function(area){area.value=rec.guided[area.dataset.guided]||'';});updateGuidedPreview();}\n      function    function independentHint(level){if(level==='hidden')return '';if(level==='skeleton')return '观点 → 原因 → 机制 → 例子 → 限定 → 回扣';return '先写清本段主张；解释为什么成立；说明原因如何产生结果；给出具体例子；必要时承认限制；最后回到中心观点。';}\n      function renderIndependent(){var      function paragraphRecordStarted(rec){return Boolean((rec.roles||[]).some(Boolean)||String(rec.breakdownNote||'').trim()||Object.keys(rec.guided||{}).some(function(k){return String(rec.guided[k]||'').trim();})||String((rec.transfer||{}).writing||'').trim()||String((rec.independent||{}).writing||'').trim());}\n      function ['claim','reason','mechanism','example','conclusion'].every(function(k){return String(rec.guided[k]||'').trim();});if(state.paragraph.mode==='transfer')return p=state.paragraph;if(!p.paragraphs.length){byId('paragraphSourceWords').textContent='0';byId('paragraphWritingWords').textContent='0';byId('paragraphSentences').textContent='0';byId('paragraphCoverage').textContent='0%';byId('paragraphChecklist').innerHTML='<li class=\"analysis-empty\">选择材料后显示检查结果。</li>';renderChips('paragraphMetaChips',[],'暂无材料');byId('paragraphSourceNote').textContent='';return;}var paragraph=p.paragraphs[p.current]||'',rec=currentParagraphRecord(),writing=currentParagraphWriting(),coverage=0,checks=[];if(p.mode==='breakdown'){coverage=rec.roles.length?Math.round(rec.roles.filter(Boolean).length/rec.roles.length*100):0;checks.push(coverage===100?'每句话都已标注功能':'还有句子没有标注功能');checks.push(String(rec.breakdownNote||'').trim()?'已经记录段落推进心得':'建议写下整体推进路径');}else if(p.mode==='guided'){var required=['claim','reason','mechanism','example','conclusion'];coverage=Math.round(required.filter(function(k){return String(rec.guided[k]||'').trim();}).length/required.length*100);checks.push(String(rec.guided.claim||'').trim()?'中心观点已填写':'缺少明确中心观点');checks.push(String(rec.guided.reason||'').trim()?'原因已填写':'缺少直接原因');checks.push(String(rec.guided.mechanism||'').trim()?'已有机制解释':'原因还没有进一步展开');checks.push(String(rec.guided.example||'').trim()?'已有例子':'缺少具体例子');checks.push(String(rec.guided.conclusion||'').trim()?'已经回扣中心':'缺少结尾回扣');}else{coverage=Math.min(100,Math.round(wordCount(writing)/80*100));checks.push(wordCount(writing)>=45?'段落已经达到基本展开长度':'内容仍较短，可能尚未充分展开');checks.push(sentenceSplit(writing).length>=4?'包含多个推进步骤':'句子数量较少，检查是否只重复了观点');var lower=' '+writing.toLowerCase()+' ';var connectorHits=[];connectorGroups.forEach(function(g){g.values.forEach(function(v){if(lower.indexOf(' '+v+' ')>=0)connectorHits.push(v);});});checks.push(connectorHits.length?'使用了连接表达：'+uniqueStrings(connectorHits).slice(0,4).join(', '):'未识别到明显连接表达；逻辑也可以通过句意自然推进');var freq={};wordList(writing).map(function(w){return w.toLowerCase();}).filter(function(w){return w.length>5;}).forEach(function(w){freq[w]=(freq[w]||0)+1;});var repeated=Object.keys(freq).filter(function(w){return freq[w]>=3;}).slice(0,3);if(repeated.length)checks.push('检查重复词：'+repeated.join(', '));}\n        byId('paragraphSourceWords').textContent=wordCount(paragraph);byId('paragraphWritingWords').textContent=wordCount(writing);byId('paragraphSentences').textContent=sentenceSplit(writing).length;byId('paragraphCoverage').textContent=coverage+'%';var list=byId('paragraphChecklist');list.innerHTML='';checks.forEach(function(v){var li=document.createElement('li');li.textContent=v;list.appendChild(li);});renderChips('paragraphMetaChips',[p.source||'Local material',p.license||'Personal study'].concat(p.tags||[]),'暂无元数据');byId('paragraphSourceNote').textContent='当前模式：'+({breakdown:'段落拆解',guided:'引导式搭建',transfer:'骨架迁移',independent:'独立段落'}[p.mode]||p.mode);}\n\n      function renderLibrary(){if(!byId('libraryGrid'))return;var query=String(byId('librarySearch').value||'').trim().toLowerCase(),category=byId('libraryCategory').value||'all';var items=libraryCache.filter(function(item){var hay=[item.title,item.category,item.source,item.license,(item.tags||[]).join(' '),item.text].join(' ').toLowerCase();return(!query||hay.indexOf(query)>=0)&&(category==='all'||item.category===category||(category==='Custom'&&!item.builtin));});byId('libraryCount').textContent=items.length+' items';var grid=byId('libraryGrid');grid.innerHTML='';if(!items.length){grid.innerHTML='<div class=\"analysis-empty\">没有匹配的材料。</div>';return;}items.forEach(function(item){var class=\"chip\">'+escapeHtml(t)+'</span>';}).join('');card.innerHTML='<h3>'+escapeHtml(item.title)+'</h3><div class=\"library-meta\">'+escapeHtml(item.category)+' · '+escapeHtml(item.source||'Unknown source')+'<br />'+escapeHtml(item.license||'Personal study')+'</div><div class=\"chips\" style=\"margin-top:8px\">'+tags+'</div><div class=\"library-preview\">'+escapeHtml(item.text)+'</div><div class=\"library-actions\"><button class=\"btn small soft\" data-use-sentence=\"'+escapeHtml(item.id)+'\">句子练习</button><button class=\"btn small primary\" data-use-paragraph=\"'+escapeHtml(item.id)+'\">段落练习</button>'+(item.builtin?'':'<button class=\"btn small danger\" data-delete-item=\"'+escapeHtml(item.id)+'\">删除</button>')+'</div>';grid.appendChild(card);});all('[data-use-sentence]').forEach(function(btn){btn.addEventListener('click',function(){useLibraryItem(this.dataset.useSentence,'sentence');});});all('[data-use-paragraph]').forEach(function(btn){btn.addEventListener('click',function(){useLibraryItem(this.dataset.useParagraph,'paragraph');});});all('[data-delete-item]').forEach(function(btn){btn.addEventListener('click',async findLibraryItem(id){return libraryCache.find(function(item){return item.id===id;});}\n      function useLibraryItem(id,lab){var item=findLibraryItem(id);if(!item)return;if(lab==='sentence'){if(state.sentence.segments.length&&sentenceHasWork()&&!window.confirm('载入新材料会替换当前句子练习，是否继续？'))return;loadSentenceItem(item);}else{if(state.paragraph.paragraphs.length&&paragraphHasWork()&&!window.confirm('载入新材料会替换当前段落练习，是否继续？'))return;loadParagraphItem(item);}state.activeLab=lab;persistNow();renderAll();showToast('已载入：'+item.title);}\n      function loadSentenceItem(item){var segments=splitSentenceMaterial(item.text,state.sentence.splitMode,state.sentence.targetWords).filter(function(v){return wordCount(v)>0;}).slice(0,300);state.sentence={materialId:item.id,title:item.title,text:item.text,source:item.source||'',license:item.license||'',tags:item.tags||[],splitMode:state.sentence.splitMode||'sentence',targetWords:45,segments:segments,answers:new Array(segments.length).fill(''),notes:new Array(segments.length).fill(''),current:0,mode:state.sentence.mode||'imitate'};}\n      function loadParagraphItem(item){var wordCount(v)>0;}).slice(0,100);state.paragraph={materialId:item.id,title:item.title,text:item.text,source:item.source||'',license:item.license||'',tags:item.tags||[],paragraphs:paragraphs,records:paragraphs.map(emptyParagraphRecord),current:0,mode:state.paragraph.mode||'breakdown'};}\n      function sentenceHasWork(){return state.sentence.answers.some(function(v){return String(v||'').trim();})||state.sentence.notes.some(function(v){return String(v||'').trim();});}\n      function paragraphHasWork(){return state.paragraph.records.some(paragraphRecordStarted);}\n\n      function commitVisibleFields(){if(state.activeLab==='sentence'&&state.sentence.segments.length){state.sentence.answers[state.sentence.current]=byId('sentenceWriter').value;state.sentence.notes[state.sentence.current]=byId('sentenceNote').value;}if(state.activeLab==='paragraph'&&state.paragraph.paragraphs.length){var      function buildSentenceCopy(indices){var s=state.sentence;var intro=s.mode==='copy'?'请比较原文与我的跟写，指出拼写、遗漏和标点问题，不要改写原文。':'请根据原文检查我的英语仿写。先诊断逻辑、语法、搭配和自然度，优先指出两个最重要的问题；尽量保留我的原意，不要立即整段重写。';var parts=['Sentence Lab · '+(s.mode==='copy'?'精准跟写':'结构仿写'),intro,''];indices.forEach(function(index,order){parts.push('--- 练习 '+(order+1)+'（原单元 '+(index+1)+'）---','Original:',s.segments[index]||'','','My writing:',String(s.answers[index]||'').trim());var note=String(s.notes[index]||'').trim();if(note)parts.push('','My analysis note:',note);parts.push('');});return parts.join('\\n').trim();}\n      function currentParagraphCopy(index){var p=state.paragraph,rec=p.records[index],source=p.paragraphs[index]||'',parts=['Paragraph Lab · '+({breakdown:'段落拆解',guided:'引导式搭建',transfer:'骨架迁移',independent:'独立段落'}[p.mode]||p.mode),'Original paragraph:',source,''];if(p.mode==='breakdown'){parts.push('My sentence-function labels:');sentenceSplit(source).forEach(function(sentence,i){parts.push((i+1)+'. ['+roleLabel(rec.roles[i])+'] '+sentence);});parts.push('','My paragraph analysis:',rec.breakdownNote||'','', 'Please check whether my labels and explanation correctly describe how the paragraph develops. Do not rewrite the paragraph.');}else if(p.mode==='guided'){parts.push('My paragraph plan:');['claim','reason','mechanism','example','qualification','conclusion'].forEach(function(k){parts.push(k+': '+(rec.guided[k]||''));});parts.push('','Combined draft:',paragraphWritingForRecord(rec,'guided'),'','Please evaluate whether each planned step supports the main claim, identify missing logical links, and ask questions before rewriting.');}else if(p.mode==='transfer'){parts.push('Logical skeleton:',skeletonFromRecord(rec),'New topic:',rec.transfer.topic||'','My paragraph:',rec.transfer.writing||'','', 'Please evaluate whether I transferred the logical structure rather than merely replacing words. Check argument development, grammar and collocation, but do not immediately rewrite the whole paragraph.');}else{parts.push('Writing task:',rec.independent.prompt||'','My paragraph:',rec.independent.writing||'','', 'Please evaluate whether every sentence advances the argument, whether the example supports the claim, what logical step is missing, and then identify grammar and collocation problems. Do not immediately rewrite the whole paragraph.');}return parts.join('\\n').trim();}\n      function fallbackCopy(text){var area=document.createElement('textarea');area.value=text;area.style.position='fixed';area.style.opacity='0';document.body.appendChild(area);area.select();var ok=document.execCommand('copy');document.body.removeChild(area);return ok;}\n      function copyText(text,message){if(!text){showToast('没有可复制的内容');return;}if(navigator.clipboard&&window.isSecureContext){navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function(){showToast(message);}).catch(function(){showToast(fallbackCopy(text)?message:'复制失败，请手动选择文本');});}else showToast(fallbackCopy(text)?message:'复制失败，请手动选择文本');}\n\n      function      function closeMaterialModal(){byId('materialModal').classList.remove('show');}\n      async function saveMaterial(){var 备份将下载');return;}btn.disabled=false;btn.querySelector('strong').textContent=backupDirectoryHandle?'备份文件夹：'+backupDirectoryHandle.name:'选择备份文件夹';updateDataMenuStatus(backupDirectoryHandle?'自动保存开启 · 已记住文件夹':'浏览器实时保存已开启');}\n      async function initializeFolder(){try{backupDirectoryHandle=await restoreDirectoryHandle();}catch(e){backupDirectoryHandle=null;}updateFolderButton();}\n      async function folderPermission(handle,request){if(!handle)return false;var options={mode:'readwrite'};if(typeof handle.queryPermission==='function'&&(await handle.queryPermission(options))==='granted')return true;if(request&&typeof handle.requestPermission==='function')return(await handle.requestPermission(options))==='granted';return false;}\n      function safeStem(value){return String(value||'writing-assistant').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\\u4e00-\\u9fa5_-]+/g,'-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g,'').slice(0,50)||'writing-assistant';}\n      function datedFileName(){var d=new Date();function p(v){return String(v).padStart(2,'0');}return safeStem((state.sentence.title||state.paragraph.title||'writing-assistant')+'-backup')+'_'+d.getFullYear()+'-'+p(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+p(d.getDate())+'_'+p(d.getHours())+'-'+p(d.getMinutes())+'-'+p(d.getSeconds())+'.json';}\n      function downloadText(text,name){var blob=new Blob([text],{type:'application/json;charset=utf-8'}),url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=name;document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(function(){URL.revokeObjectURL(url);},0);}\n      async function saveBackup(){commitVisibleFields();persistNow();var custom=[];try{custom=await dbGetAll(LIBRARY_STORE);}catch(e){}var backup={schemaVersion:4,appVersion:APP_VERSION,exportedAt:new '隐藏' : '显示';\n  }\n\n  function readFormConfig() {\n    return {\n      provider: byId('aiProvider').value,\n      adapter: byId('aiAdapter').value,\n      baseUrl: trimmed(byId('aiBaseUrl').value),\n      endpoint: trimmed(byId('aiEndpoint').value),\n      model: trimmed(byId('aiModel').value),\n      maxTokens: Math.min(4000, Math.max(256, Number(byId('aiMaxTokens').value) || 1800)),\n      temperature: Math.min(1.5, Math.max(0, Number(byId('aiTemperature').value) || 0)),\n      feedbackLanguage: byId('aiFeedbackLanguage').value,\n      storageMode: byId('aiStorageMode').value,\n      anthropicVersion: trimmed(byId('aiAnthropicVersion').value) || '2023-06-01'\n    };\n  }\n\n  function validateConfig(next, key) {\n    if (!next.baseUrl) throw new Error('请填写Base URL。');\n    if (!/^https:\\/\\//i.test(next.baseUrl)) throw new Error('Base URL必须使用HTTPS。');\n    if (!next.model) throw new Error('请填写模型名称。');\n    if (!key) throw new Error('请填写或解锁API Key。');\n  }\n\n  async function saveSettings(silent) {\n    try {\n      var next = readFormConfig();\n      var key = trimmed(byId('aiApiKey').value) || runtimeApiKey || sessionKey();\n      if (!key && next.storageMode === 'encrypted' && localStorage.getItem(ENCRYPTED_KEY)) {\n        var passwordForUnlock = byId('aiVaultPassword').value;\n        if (passwordForUnlock) key = await decryptStoredKey(passwordForUnlock);\n      }\n      validateConfig(next, key);\n      config = next;\n      runtimeApiKey = key;\n      if (config.storageMode === 'session') {\n        try { sessionStorage.setItem(SESSION_KEY, key); } catch (e) {}\n      } else {\n        var password = byId('aiVaultPassword').value;\n        if (!password || password.length < 8) throw new Error('本地加密密码至少需要8个字符。');\n        await encryptAndStoreKey(key, password);\n        try { sessionStorage.removeItem(SESSION_KEY); ' ' + state : '');\n  }\n\n  async function testConnection() {\n    var button = byId('aiTestBtn');\n    button.disabled = true;\n    setTestStatus('正在测试连接……', '');\n    try {\n      var next = readFormConfig();\n      var key = trimmed(byId('aiApiKey').value) || runtimeApiKey || sessionKey();\n      if (!key && next.storageMode === 'encrypted' && localStorage.getItem(ENCRYPTED_KEY)) {\n        var password = byId('aiVaultPassword').value;\n        if (password) key = await decryptStoredKey(password);\n      }\n      validateConfig(next, key);\n      var result = await requestModel(next, key, 'You are a connection tester. Reply with exactly OK.', 'Reply exactly: OK', { maxTokens: 12, timeoutMs: 30000 });\n      if (!/ok/i.test(result)) throw new Error('服务已响应，但没有返回预期测试文本。');\n      config = next;\n      runtimeApiKey = key;\n      setTestStatus('连接成功：' + providerPreset(next.provider).label + ' · ' + next.model, 'ok');\n    } catch (error) {\n      setTestStatus(friendlyError(error), 'error');\n    } finally {\n      activeRequest = null;\n      button.disabled = false;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async function unlockSavedKey() {\n    try {\n      var password = byId('aiVaultPassword').value;\n      if (!password) throw new Error('请输入本地加密密码。');\n      runtimeApiKey = await decryptStoredKey(password);\n      byId('aiApiKey').value = runtimeApiKey;\n      byId('aiKeyState').textContent = '已解锁；密钥只保留在当前页面内存中。';\n      updateConnectionBadge();\n      showToast('已解锁本地密钥');\n    } catch (error) {\n      showToast(error.message || '解锁失败');\n    }\n  }\n\n  function removeSavedKey() {\n    if (!window.confirm('确定移除当前标签页密钥和本机加密密钥吗？')) return;\n    runtimeApiKey = '';\n    try { sessionStorage.removeItem(SESSION_KEY); i < bytes.length; i++) binary += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);\n    return window.btoa(binary);\n  }\n\n  function base64ToBytes(value) {\n    var binary = window.atob(value);\n    var bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);\n    for (var i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);\n    return bytes;\n  }\n\n  async function deriveEncryptionKey(password, salt) {\n    if (!window.crypto || !window.crypto.subtle) throw new Error('当前浏览器不支持Web Crypto加密。');\n    var material = await window.crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(password), 'PBKDF2', false, ['deriveKey']);\n    return window.crypto.subtle.deriveKey(\n      { name: 'PBKDF2', salt: salt, iterations: 250000, hash: 'SHA-256' },\n      material,\n      { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 },\n      false,\n      ['encrypt', 'decrypt']\n    );\n  }\n\n  async function encryptAndStoreKey(apiKey, password) {\n    var salt = window.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));\n    var iv = window.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));\n    var key = await deriveEncryptionKey(password, salt);\n    var encrypted = await window.crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv: iv }, key, new TextEncoder().encode(apiKey));\n    localStorage.setItem(ENCRYPTED_KEY, JSON.stringify({\n      version: 1,\n      salt: bytesToBase64(salt),\n      iv: bytesToBase64(iv),\n      cipher: bytesToBase64(new Uint8Array(encrypted))\n    }));\n  }\n\n  async function decryptStoredKey(password) {\n    var raw = localStorage.getItem(ENCRYPTED_KEY);\n    if (!raw) throw new Error('没有找到已加密密钥。');\n    try {\n      var record = JSON.parse(raw);\n      var salt = base64ToBytes(record.salt);\n      var iv = base64ToBytes(record.iv);\n      var cipher = base64ToBytes(record.cipher);\n      var key = await deriveEncryptionKey(password, salt);\n      var plain = await window.crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv: iv }, key, cipher);\n      return new TextDecoder().decode(plain);\n    } catch (error) {\n      throw new Error('密码错误，或本地密钥数据已损坏。');\n    }\n  }\n\n  function feedbackLanguageInstruction() {\n    return config.feedbackLanguage === 'en'\n      ? 'Reply entirely in English.'\n      : 'Use Chinese for explanations and keep quoted English fragments in English.';\n  }\n\n  function delimited(label, value) {\n    var content = text(value);\n    if (content.length > MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS) content = content.slice(0, MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS) + '\\n[Content truncated by Writing Assistant]';\n    return '<<<' + label + '>>>\\n' + content + '\\n<<<END ' + label + '>>>';\n  }\n\n  function gatherSentenceContext() {\n    var original = trimmed(byId('sentenceTarget') && byId('sentenceTarget').textContent);\n    return { kind: 'sentence', original: original };\n  }\n\n  function gatherParagraphContext() {\n    var original = all('#roleRows .sentence-text').map(function (node) {\n      return node.textContent.replace(/^\\s*\\d+\\.\\s*/, '').trim();\n    }).join(' ');\n    return { kind: 'paragraph', original: original };\n  }\n\n  function buildSentencePrompt(ctx) {\n    return [\n      feedbackLanguageInstruction(),\n      'Task: analyse the REFERENCE SENTENCE only.',\n      'The source may be a model essay sentence, literary sentence, academic sentence or other practice text.',\n      'Do not discuss or infer anything about the learner or the learner\\'s imitation.',\n      '',\n      delimited('REFERENCE SENTENCE', ctx.original),\n      '',\n      'Return exactly these sections:',\n      '## 简明释义 / Meaning',\n      'Explain the sentence meaning and communicative purpose concisely.',\n      '## 句子骨架 / Sentence skeleton',\n      'Identify the main clause and express the reusable grammatical skeleton abstractly.',\n      '## 从句与修饰 / Clauses and modifiers',\n      'Explain subordinate clauses, phrases, modifiers and information order. Omit this section only when none are meaningful.',\n      '## 词汇与搭配 / Vocabulary and collocation',\n      'Select a small number of high-value words or chunks, explain their role, register and common usage constraints.',\n      '## 语域与风格 / Register and style',\n      'Describe whether the wording is academic, argumentative, literary, neutral, formal or conversational, using observable evidence.',\n      '## 可迁移模板 / Transferable pattern',\n      'Provide one abstract template with placeholders. Do not reproduce the whole source as a rewritten answer.',\n      '## 仿写提醒 / Imitation checklist',\n      'Give three concise points a learner should notice when imitating this structure. Do not assess any learner writing.'\n    ].join('\\n');\n  }\n\n  function buildParagraphPrompt(ctx) {\n    return [\n      feedbackLanguageInstruction(),\n      'Task: analyse the REFERENCE PARAGRAPH only.',\n      'The source may be a model essay paragraph, literary passage, academic paragraph or other practice text.',\n      'Do not discuss or infer anything about the learner, learner labels, plans, notes or writing.',\n      '',\n      delimited('REFERENCE PARAGRAPH', ctx.original),\n      '',\n      'Return exactly these sections:',\n      '## 段落类型与主旨 / Type and central purpose',\n      'Identify the likely genre and the paragraph\\'s central communicative purpose. State uncertainty when necessary.',\n      '## 逐句功能地图 / Sentence-function map',\n      'Number the sentences and explain what each contributes, such as claim, reason, mechanism, example, evidence, qualification, transition, description or narrative movement.',\n      '## 推进链 / Development chain',\n      'Summarise how information develops from the first sentence to the last. Mark any deliberate shift, contrast or narrowing.',\n      '## 衔接与连贯 / Cohesion and coherence',\n      'Explain connectors, reference words, lexical repetition, topic continuity and other cohesion devices.',\n      '## 关键表达 / High-value language',\n      'Select a limited set of useful collocations, sentence frames or rhetorical moves and explain their register and constraints.',\n      '## 可迁移骨架 / Transferable skeleton',\n      'Express the paragraph as an abstract sequence that can be reused with a different topic.',\n      '## 仿写提醒 / Imitation checklist',\n      'Give four concise points a learner should preserve or adapt when imitating the paragraph. Do not evaluate learner work.'\n    ].join('\\n');\n  }\n\n  function contextFor(kind) { return kind === 'sentence' ? gatherSentenceContext() : gatherParagraphContext(); }\n  function promptFor(kind, ctx) { return kind === 'sentence' ? buildSentencePrompt(ctx) : buildParagraphPrompt(ctx); i < input.length; i++) {\n      hash ^= input.charCodeAt(i);\n      hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);\n    }\n    return (hash >>> 0).toString(36);\n  }\n\n  function feedbackId(kind, ctx) { return kind + '-' + hashString(JSON.stringify(ctx)); }\n  }\n\n  function saveFeedback(record) {\n    var list = loadFeedbackStore().filter(function (item) { return item.id !== record.id; });\n    list.unshift(record);\n    if (list.length > MAX_ANALYSIS_RECORDS) list = list.slice(0, MAX_ANALYSIS_RECORDS);\n    try {\n      localStorage.setItem(ANALYSIS_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));\n    } catch (e) {\n      while (list.length > 20) list.pop();\n      try { localStorage.setItem(ANALYSIS_KEY, JSON.stringify(list)); error.message : 'AI请求失败。';\n    if (/Failed to fetch|NetworkError|Load failed/i.test(message)) {\n      return '无法连接服务商：可能是网络、Base URL或浏览器CORS限制。密钥正确也可能因服务商禁止网页直连而失败。';\n    }\n    if (/401|unauthorized|invalid api key|authentication/i.test(message)) return '认证失败：请检查API Key、服务商和Base URL。';\n    if (/403|forbidden/i.test(message)) return '请求被拒绝：请检查账户权限、地区限制或浏览器直连策略。';\n    if (/429|rate limit|quota/i.test(message)) return '额度或频率受限：请检查账户余额、限速与模型权限。';\n    if (/timeout/i.test(message)) return '请求超时：可重试，或选择响应更快的模型。';\n    return message;\n  }\n\n  async function requestModel(next, apiKey, systemPrompt, userPrompt, options) {\n    var controller = new AbortController();\n    activeRequest = controller;\n    var timeout = window.setTimeout(function () { controller.abort(); }, options.timeoutMs || 90000);\n    try {\n      if (next.adapter === 'gemini') return await requestGemini(next, apiKey, systemPrompt, userPrompt, options, controller.signal);\n      if (next.adapter === 'anthropic') return await requestAnthropic(next, apiKey, systemPrompt, userPrompt, options, controller.signal);\n      return await requestOpenAI(next, apiKey, systemPrompt, userPrompt, options, controller.signal);\n    } finally {\n      window.clearTimeout(timeout);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async function parseErrorResponse(response) {\n    var body = '';\n    try { body = await response.text(); } catch (e) {}\n    var detail = body;\n    try {\n      var parsed = JSON.parse(body);\n      detail = (parsed.error && (parsed.error.message || parsed.error.status)) || parsed.message || body;\n    } catch (e) {}\n    detail = text(detail).slice(0, 600);\n    throw new Error('HTTP ' + response.status + (detail ? ': ' + detail : ''));\n  }\n\n  async function requestOpenAI(next, apiKey, systemPrompt, userPrompt, options, signal) {\n    var response = await fetch(joinUrl(next.baseUrl, next.endpoint || '/v1/chat/completions'), {\n      method: 'POST',\n      signal: signal,\n      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + apiKey },\n      body: JSON.stringify((function () {\n        var payload = {\n          model: next.model,\n          messages: [\n            { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt },\n            { role: 'user', content: userPrompt }\n          ],\n          temperature: next.temperature,\n          max_tokens: options.maxTokens || next.maxTokens || 1800,\n          stream: false\n        };\n        if (next.provider === 'deepseek') payload.thinking = { type: 'disabled' };\n        return payload;\n      }()))\n    });\n    if (!response.ok) return parseErrorResponse(response);\n    var data = await response.json();\n    var content = data && data.choices && data.choices[0] && data.choices[0].message && data.choices[0].message.content;\n    if (Array.isArray(content)) content = content.map(function (part) { return part.text || part.content || ''; }).join('');\n    if (!trimmed(content)) throw new Error('服务已响应，但没有返回可显示的文本。');\n    return trimmed(content);\n  }\n\n  async function requestGemini(next, apiKey, systemPrompt, userPrompt, options, signal) {\n    var endpoint = joinUrl(next.baseUrl, 'models/' + encodeURIComponent(next.model) + ':generateContent');\n    var response = await fetch(endpoint, {\n      method: 'POST',\n      signal: signal,\n      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-goog-api-key': apiKey },\n      body: JSON.stringify({\n        system_instruction: { parts: [{ text: systemPrompt }] },\n        contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: userPrompt }] }],\n        generationConfig: {\n          temperature: next.temperature,\n          maxOutputTokens: options.maxTokens || next.maxTokens || 1800\n        }\n      })\n    });\n    if (!response.ok) return parseErrorResponse(response);\n    var data = await response.json();\n    var parts = data && data.candidates && data.candidates[0] && data.candidates[0].content && data.candidates[0].content.parts;\n    var result = Array.isArray(parts) ? parts.map(function (part) { return part.text || ''; }).join('') : '';\n    if (!trimmed(result)) throw new Error('Gemini已响应，但没有返回可显示的文本。');\n    return trimmed(result);\n  }\n\n  async function requestAnthropic(next, apiKey, systemPrompt, userPrompt, options, signal) {\n    var response = await fetch(joinUrl(next.baseUrl, next.endpoint || '/v1/messages'), {\n      method: 'POST',\n      signal: signal,\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n        'x-api-key': apiKey,\n        'anthropic-version': next.anthropicVersion || '2023-06-01',\n        'anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access': 'true'\n      },\n      body: JSON.stringify({\n        model: next.model,\n        system: systemPrompt,\n        messages: [{ role: 'user', content: userPrompt }],\n        max_tokens: options.maxTokens || next.maxTokens || 1800,\n        temperature: next.temperature\n      })\n    });\n    if (!response.ok) return parseErrorResponse(response);\n    var data = await response.json();\n    var result = Array.isArray(data.content) ? data.content.map(function (part) { return part.type === 'text' ? part.text : ''; not official IELTS content\",\n    \"tags\": [\n      \"technology\",\n      \"education\",\n      \"argument\"\n    ],\n    \"text\": \"Artificial intelligence can make independent learning more efficient, but it should not replace the learner’s own judgment. Digital tools are useful because they can identify repeated language errors and provide immediate examples. This feedback allows students to revise while their reasoning process is still fresh. For instance, a learner may compare two versions of the same paragraph and discover that the weaker version merely repeats its main claim. However, students who accept every automated suggestion without reflection may become less capable of evaluating their own work. Therefore, AI is most valuable when it supports a cycle of writing, feedback and deliberate rewriting.\\n\\nSchools should teach students how to question automated feedback rather than simply how to obtain it. Such training would help learners distinguish corrections based on grammar from suggestions that merely reflect stylistic preference. It would also encourage them to verify factual claims before including them in academic work. Although this approach requires more classroom time, it may prevent students from becoming passive users of increasingly powerful tools. For instance, a learner may compare two versions of the same paragraph and discover that the weaker version merely repeats its main claim. However, students who accept every automated suggestion without reflection may become less capable of evaluating their own work. export default {
  async fetch(request) {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    const file = FILES[url.pathname] || FILES['/'];
    return new Response(file.body, {
      headers: {
        'content-type': file.type,
        'cache-control': url.pathname === '/' || url.pathname === '/index.html' ? 'no-cache' : 'public, max-age=3600',
        'x-content-type-options': 'nosniff',
        'referrer-policy': 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin'
      }
    });
  }
};
